'''Steven Harpster Hunt Down And Win the Sabacc''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Steve Harpster]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-12326">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12326 Hunt Down And Win the Sabacc], DeckTech (steven "Harpster" Harpster, 15 December 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/12326/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/12326/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018084322/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12326/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Steve Harpster]]
* '''Published:''' 15 December 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Hunt Down And Win the Sabacc''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 HD Harpster DS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' You set up at Cloud city and Tatooine, while making them lose additional force from Visage, then you retreive all you lost force by sabacc, and you can even duel, This deck has great destiny.

== Original post ==

'''Hunt Down And Win the Sabacc'''
* '''Author:''' steven "Harpster" Harpster
* '''Published:''' December 15, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' You set up at Cloud city and Tatooine, while making them lose additional force from Visage, then you retreive all you lost force by sabacc, and you can even duel, This deck has great destiny.

=== Strategy ===

First you play Prepared Defense To get out IAO, crush the reb.,Mobilization points then that allows you to take out cc-db,tat-db,exe-db, and mobilizations points allow for you to activate extra off of the db's, you make them lose to visage, I honestly can say I have played with this deck for sometime now And in my opening hand have had a vader everytime, You have anti hiddenbase, and anti training, then you set up at the cc casino, and then you can go to casino, and downtown plaza, then you forcedrain, That is very useful, Iao gives you a good advantage with those ability two imperials. I also dont like for people to try to beat me down then leave.

I retreive alot with CC sabbac, The three dreadnaughts are in there beacause of the destiny of 3, alot better than those bh ships, well.

Try this deck and please if you have any comments or anything feel free to email me at iliv4starwars@aol.com

thanx

Steven (Harpster) Harpster out
